description.value: Firecrust Neapolitan Pizzeria is a fast-casual chain specializing in customizable Neapolitan-style pizzas and salads built from over 30 premium ingredients, including a notable range of vegan substitutes. Inspired by authentic Naples pizzerias, the restaurant uses non-GMO 00 flour and Italian tomato sauce for its bases. The Langley location is one of two BC outposts in a small Canadian franchise and offers dine-in, takeout, and third-party delivery.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms an active Neapolitan pizza restaurant offering dine-in, takeout, and delivery; the OSM coordinates (49.113°N, 122.664°W) align with the Langley location listed on the website at 40-20160 Langley Bypass. The menu explicitly names multiple vegan ingredients and products, and takeout is confirmed by the homepage banner and third-party delivery links. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, washrooms) are mentioned anywhere on the website, and the OSM addr:unit value 'F030' conflicts with the website's unit designation '40', which is flagged.
concerns: OSM addr:unit is 'F030' but website lists the Langley location as unit '40' at 20160 Langley Bypass — likely a unit-numbering discrepancy between the mall operator and the tenant; address and phone sourced from website.
OSM record has no full address and no phone number.

Website locations page lists only 2 active locations (Davie, Vancouver and Langley) while the franchise page references 4 locations including Lloydminster and Grande Prairie — website may be partially outdated.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The restaurant offers relevant cyclist amenities (takeout, vegan/vegetarian menu) but none of the three required WWC criteria can be confirmed from the website; an on-site visit would be needed to verify bike parking, water refill, and washroom access.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Menu lists Vegan Sausage, Vegan Chicken, Vegan Mozza (contains nuts), Vegan Parmesan, and Vegan Hickory BBQ Sauce; vegetarian pizzas include Margherita, Vegetale, and Quattro Formaggi. No gluten-free option mentioned
